name: mp
effect: Determines the amount of spells and skills a unit can cast/use.

name: strength
effect: Determines the power of physical attacks.

name: defense
effect: Determines the reduction of physical damage taken.

name: magic
effect: Determines the power of magical attacks.

name: magic defense
effect: Determines the reduction of magical damage taken.

name: agility
effect: Determines how often a unit gets a turn.

name: luck
effect: Determines the chance of landing and evading a physical attack, as well as the chance of landing a critical hit.

name: evasion
effect: Determines the chance of evading a physical attack.

name: accuracy
effect: Determines the chance of landing a physical attack.
